title: A United Front Against Debt
author: Thomas Sankara
context: Delivered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on July 29, 1987, at the summit of the Organization of African Unity, this landmark speech by Captain Thomas Sankara calls for a continental refusal to pay foreign debt, exposing sovereign debt as an instrument of neocolonial reconquest.
relatesToToday: Provides an essential foundation for contemporary anti-imperialist critiques of IMF and World Bank debt traps, structural adjustment programmes, odious debt, and the ongoing struggle for Global South economic sovereignty.
keyTakeaways: Third-world debt originates in colonial conquest and continues the extraction of African resources under modern financial disguises.
Debt repayment is a matter of life and death: while imperialist banks can withstand non-payment, African working masses cannot survive debt servicing.
Only a united, collective front among oppressed nations can successfully resist imperialist retaliation, debt enslavement, and targeted assassinations.
